label: dam-probe-p13-aiself-contest
_why: ENGINE PROBE, two questions in one run. (1) Does the engine's own AI build dams once they carry ownership_type = self? (user, 2026-09-27: 'For the test, remove scripted queue adds. I suspect that the reason AI never built the dams without them is the same declaration that we just removed.') Every earlier probe (p6-p12) and century run had dams WITHOUT an ownership_type, which the engine treats like an administration (refused in a foreign state, CANNOT_EXPAND_BUILDING_NOT_OWNABLE, found in the user's playtest), and the AI never queued a dam itself (F169). (2) THE CONTEST (user, the same day: 'the probes need to have multiple possible investors to check that once one starts building, others got locked out and don't waste a lot of money there'): at the start every dam site whose owner is a SUBJECT is seeded with several eligible builders - the owner and every country above it get the class technologies and a completed survey - and every standing dam logs monthly its built level and its level after all queued constructions. Arm = config/mod_config.canon-dams-aiself-probe.json {kind: config}: the probe book (dam technologies granted to ten majors, 2-month surveys, level cost x0.25 - not x0.05, so constructions overlap in time long enough to collide - USA/FRA on laissez-faire) + dams.probe.contest + dams.ai.driver_build = false and driver_finance = false: the quarterly driver only SURVEYS; no start_building_construction, no financed level. Any dam level that appears was queued by the engine's AI. + ELECTRICITY DEMAND FROM 1836 (user, the same day: 'If noone starts building dams, this could well be because there's no electricity demand. Try adding some.'): pm_goods gives pm_no_public_transport - run by every urban centre from 1836, ungated - an input of 1 electricity per level, so every market wants electricity from the first week and, with no supply, its price sits at the 175% band edge. Probe only (urban centres short of the input lose output).

_questions.Q1: Does any AI country queue a dam level in its OWN state?
_questions.Q2: Does any AI overlord queue a dam level in a SUBJECT's state through its own government queue (a level owned by a foreign country in the host's ownership split)?
_questions.Q3: Does anything land in a PRIVATE queue, or end up owned by a financial district / company (can_build_private stays always = no; USA and France on laissez-faire)?
_questions.Q4: Once one country queues a level, are the others locked out? i.e. does a dam ever read more queued levels than its cap (probe_q above N/N), or do two countries hold the SAME dam in their government queues beyond the free levels?
_questions.Q5: Is money wasted: does a dam construction ever vanish without its level rising (probe_q falling while probe_lvl stays; a queue element present one quarter and gone the next with no level gained)?
_questions.Q6: Does a poor SUBJECT owner grab a level and sit on it (a dam element in a subject's government queue with little or no speed while its overlord is locked out) - the F170 stall, now without the driver's owner capacity gate?

_predictions.Q1: yes, in at least two of the ten granted majors within three years (ai_value 30,000, must_have subsidies) - low confidence: F169's null may have another cause
_predictions.Q2: rarer than Q1 if at all - the government AI's foreign construction is a separate, sparser path
_predictions.Q4: locked out: the cap counts every builder's queued levels (level_after_queued_constructions, vanilla's trade-centre idiom) - never above N/N
_predictions.Q5: no cancellation - in v3 Britain's own last levels (Lochaber, Galloway) completed while the cap read full, so the game does not re-check can_build_government on a construction under way
_predictions.Q6: yes, somewhere: nothing restrains a poor owner once the driver's capacity gate is gone - if so, the gate belongs in can_build_government

_read: debug.log: PMR_DAM probe_contest_seed (which sites were seeded, by owner), probe_lvl / probe_q per dam per month, survey_* and built lines (no stage_start or finance_* lines can appear - the driver emits none). Save summaries (quarterly): every country's queues.government.by_type / queues.private.by_type building_dam_* (n, points left), building_dam_* levels and ownership_levels by owner class.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Probe build: techs granted, costs and surveys shrunk, subjects' chains seeded, urban centres made to buy electricity - do not read any economic number from it.

If Q1 is still null WITH the demand, the cause is neither the ownership type nor the market: the next suspects are the building group (bg_private_infrastructure carries no foreign_investment_ai_factor and no economy weighting the AI's build scoring may need) and the survey-gated potential.
A null on Q1/Q2 is NOT conclusive for the canon: at canon costs and real technology dates the AI's weighing differs - the century arm canon_dams_aiself_n1 answers that.
